item.tib: zhi ba rin chen spyi spungs kyi mngon rtogs gsal ba'i sgron ma
item.coloph: zhi ba rin chen spyi spung gi (spungs kyi) mngon rtogs gsal ba'i sgron ma/ dbra btsun nam mkha' rin chen gyis sbyar ba/ 'dus pa don gsal zhes bya ba/ gsang ba'i man ngag u ya smar ro/ rim par brgyud nas bdag gi nyams len no//
